module.purpose: Provides Solid.js helpers for suspending on deferred promises and rendering asynchronous results with optional fallback UI.
module.summary: This module adapts TanStack Router deferred promises to Solid.js resource and suspense primitives. It exposes a hook-like function that returns resolved data or propagates pending and error states, plus a rendering helper that chooses between deferred streaming behavior and explicit suspense fallback behavior. An internal renderer resolves resource data for the fallback path.
module.businessContext: Supports asynchronous route data loading in Solid applications. Failure can prevent route content from rendering or propagate promise and data-loading errors.
functions: useAwaited (~L11-23): Defers a promise and exposes resolved data or throws its pending/error state.
Await (~L25-52): Renders promise results with optional fallback behavior using Solid resources and suspense.
AwaitInner (~L54-66): Resolves a deferred resource and passes its data to child content.
systemCapabilities: Suspend rendering for unresolved route data
Render asynchronous results in Solid components

module.moduleLevelCode:
import * as Solid from 'solid-js'

import { TSR_DEFERRED_PROMISE, defer } from '@tanstack/router-core'
import type { DeferredPromise } from '@tanstack/router-core'
import type { SolidNode } from './route'

detail.name: useAwaited
detail.signature: export function useAwaited<T>({ promise: _promise, }: AwaitOptions<T>): [data: T, promise: DeferredPromise<T>]
preconditions: The argument conforms to AwaitOptions<T> and supplies a promise value.
postconditions: A non-pending, non-error deferred promise is returned together with its resolved data.
invariants: The deferred promise is created from the supplied promise before its status is inspected.
The same deferred promise instance used for status inspection is returned on successful completion.
edgeCases: When the deferred promise status is pending, the deferred promise itself is thrown.
When the deferred promise status is error, the stored error is thrown.

raises: The deferred promise object when its status is pending.
The stored deferred-promise error when its status is error.

detail.summary: Resolves an awaited promise through the deferred-promise mechanism and provides its data together with the deferred promise. Pending deferred promises are thrown for suspense, while rejected promises propagate their stored error.

units.name: Await

detail.name: Await
detail.signature: export function Await<T>(props: AwaitOptions<T> & { fallback?: SolidNode; children: (result: T) => SolidNode })

parameters.name: props
parameters.type: AwaitOptions<T> & { fallback?: SolidNode; children: (result: T) => SolidNode }

preconditions: props.promise must satisfy the AwaitOptions<T> contract.
props.children must be a function accepting a resolved T value and returning a SolidNode.
postconditions: Returns a SolidNode representing asynchronous result rendering.
When the fallback property is absent, the promise is deferred through a Solid resource configured for streaming and the children renderer is invoked only when the resource produces a value.
When the fallback property is present, the child rendering is delegated inside Solid.Suspense using props.fallback as its fallback content.
invariants: The resolved value passed to props.children is typed and treated as T.
The presence of the fallback property, rather than only its value, selects the rendering branch.
edgeCases: If props has no fallback property, a deferred Solid resource is created and the result is rendered conditionally through Solid.Show.
If props has a fallback property whose value is undefined, the fallback branch is selected and Solid.Suspense receives undefined as its fallback.
If the promise has not resolved or the resource has no value, the no-fallback branch does not invoke props.children through Solid.Show.
detail.summary: Renders the resolved result of a promise through the supplied children renderer. When a fallback is provided, it wraps the rendering in Solid suspense; otherwise it creates a deferred resource and conditionally renders once the resource has a value.

specTests.then: It creates a deferred resource with streaming enabled and renders the children result conditionally through Solid.Show.
It returns a Solid.Suspense boundary whose fallback is props.fallback and whose content is rendered by AwaitInner with the supplied props.

units.name: AwaitInner

detail.name: AwaitInner

parameters.name: props

preconditions: props.promise is supplied as required by AwaitOptions<T>.
props.children is a function accepting a resolved value of type T.
postconditions: The promise is deferred before being supplied to Solid's resource creation mechanism.
The promise result is passed through unchanged as the resource value.
invariants: The resource source returns the deferred promise.
The resource fetcher preserves the resolved value without transformation.
edgeCases: When the promise resolves to any value, that value is preserved unchanged by the resource fetcher.
When the promise rejects, rejection handling is delegated to Solid's resource mechanism and surrounding await boundary.
When fallback is omitted, no fallback value is supplied by this unit's props contract.
detail.summary: Creates the reactive resource used to resolve the promise supplied through the await options and renders the awaited result through the provided children function.
